statements.status_notes: CVE-2023-45922 reports an out-of-bounds read in __glXGetDrawableAttribute() in Mesa's GLX client code (src/glx/glx_pbuffer.c): it walks the number of attributes the X server states in its reply rather than the amount of data it read (https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/mesa/mesa/-/issues/9857). The CVE record is tagged disputed because there are no common situations in which users require uninterrupted operation with an attacker-controlled server (https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-45922), but it does not say who disputed it, and the upstream issue is still open with no response from the Mesa developers, so there is no upstream ruling to rely on. The published mesa package ships Mesa's GLX client library as libGLX_mesa.so.0 in libglx-mesa0, built from Mesa 25.0.7 with the Debian 25.0.7-2+deb13u1 changes. In Mesa 25.0.7 the loop still uses the server-supplied numAttribs without checking it against the reply length. Debian tracks it as unimportant and unfixed (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2023-45922). Pending: a ruling or fix from Mesa on issue 9857.
